name: mt3d_desert_afix
setup: python3 -m pip install -q numba==0.67.0 scipy opencv-python-headless==4.10.0.84 numpy || python3 -m pip install -q numba numpy scipy opencv-python-headless

(apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq libxrender1 libxxf86vm1 libxfixes3 libxi6 libxkbcommon0 libsm6 libgl1 libegl1 libegl-mesa0 libgl1-mesa-dri libgbm1 > /tmp/apt.log 2>&1 && echo apt ok) || echo 'apt unavailable'
render: cd shots/montage3d && EGL_PLATFORM=surfaceless MT3D_REFIG=1 MT3D_BLENDER=$HOME/bpyenv/bin/python python3 render.py desert --final --force --outdir renders/montage3d_v3/desert_src --range 1520-1579
